{{Short description|Certain cohomology groups of coherent sheaves are separated}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''Andreotti–Vesentini separation theorem''', introduced by {{harvs|txt | last1=Andreotti | first1=Aldo | last2=Vesentini | first2=Edoardo | author1-link=Aldo Andreotti|author2-link=Edoardo Vesentini| year=1965 | year2=1965b}} states that certain [[cohomology group]]s of [[coherent sheaf|coherent sheaves]] are separated.
